## Summary

What does this PR change and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] Type check passes (`npm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Formatting is clean (`npm run format:check`)
- [ ] Documentation updated (README / CONFIGURATION.md / CHANGELOG.md)

## Conventional Commit title

PR titles follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/), e.g. `feat(checker): add XYZ`.
